_note: color-verifier's checked-in routing corpus — the test of record. POSITIVES cover the verify/check/audit-my-UI-color families across phrasing (contrast pairs, CVD/color-blind safety, OKLCH ramp construction + perceptual evenness, semantic role assignment, theme×scheme×contrast verification). NEGATIVES are ADVERSARIAL: the OTHER FOUR sibling verifiers' concerns (each a NEGATIVE here and labelled with the sibling that owns it), plus color-science (color THEORY / palette MATH — not a pass/fail UI check) and component-decomposer (BUILDING a control, not verifying color). Re-derive when the verifier neighbourhood changes. NOTE: routing-eval measures lexical overlap ONLY — a paraphrase positive that shares no surface words may score recall 0; that is a proxy limit, not a defect.
positives: verify my UI palette clears WCAG AA contrast on every text pair
check the contrast ratio between my button text and its background
audit my color scheme for color-blind safety
is this palette accessible for deuteranopia and protanopia users
build an OKLCH ramp from my brand anchor and prove the contrast holds
extend my accent palette to a full 11-step scale with even lightness steps
verify the contrast floor holds across light, dark, and prefers-contrast
does my danger color pass 3:1 against the surface it sits on
assign semantic color roles and check each contrast-bearing pair
derive a dark-scheme palette and verify every pair against the floor
check my ramp for perceptual evenness and hue stability
verify focus-ring color contrast against the page background
are my on-surface text tokens passing APCA and WCAG 2.2
audit this candidate palette for out-of-gamut steps and contrast failures
negatives: verify the focus order and keyboard tab sequence through this form (focus-verifier)
check that my interactive targets meet the 24x24 hit-target minimum (focus-verifier)
audit this UI for RTL support and logical-property usage (i18n-verifier)
verify my copy has enough text-expansion headroom for German and Russian (i18n-verifier)
check that dates and currencies flow through Intl formatting per locale (i18n-verifier)
verify the loading skeleton vs spinner decision and CLS budget (perf-verifier)
audit perceived latency and the feedback recipe for this async surface (perf-verifier)
check that destructive deletes use undo or type-to-confirm (safety-verifier)
verify the blast radius and audit-trail UX for bulk actions (safety-verifier)
explain the OKLCH color space math and how chroma maps to hue (color-science)
what is the color theory behind a split-complementary harmony (color-science)
build a zero-dependency color-picker web component with the right geometry (component-decomposer)
design the API and parts of a swatch component (component-decomposer)
